battle.name: 哈蘭的陷落
battle.brief: 610 年，薩珊將軍沙赫巴巴茲以約一年時間圍困哈蘭，最終攻陷這座位於幼發拉底河上游的邊城。拜占庭守軍在城牆與街壘之間，以羅馬方陣盾結成的盾牆抵禦投射物與近身衝撞，卻終因存糧耗盡與城防失修而崩潰。哈蘭的失守，成為赫拉克利烏斯放棄守城、全面反攻薩珊的起點。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 610 年的哈蘭之戰，是薩珊帝國與拜占庭帝國在拜占庭-薩珊戰爭（602 至 628 年）東線上的一段。交戰的一方是薩珊波斯：皇帝霍斯勞二世坐鎮泰西封，其亞美尼亞出身的將軍沙赫巴巴茲率領圍城大軍，軍隊以重裝鐵甲騎兵、弓弩手與攻城工兵混編，軍令自泰西封經美索不達米亞的驛傳下達，邊地守軍則由總督與軍團統帥分區防衛。另一方是拜占庭帝國：上美索不達米亞與敘利亞仍由帝國的總督及軍事統帥分轄，哈蘭由常備兵與邊防軍團防守，援軍須自安條克、卡佩冬尼亞與小亞美尼亞的指揮部抽調。610 年上半年拜占庭的皇帝位空懸，福卡斯被推翻，赫拉克利烏斯自小亞細亞登基，東線的指揮鏈一度斷裂。薩珊方面還扶植傀儡政權，把哈蘭與埃德薩變成反拜占庭的橋頭堡。兩個帝國的邊界就壓在哈蘭城下：一方要取下這座門戶，一方要守住通往安條克的北道。
countriesEn: The fall of Harran in 610 was a segment of the eastern front of the Byzantine-Sasanian War of 602-628, fought over the frontier city of Harran on the upper Euphrates. One side was Sasanian Persia: the king of kings Khosrow II held his court at Ctesiphon, and his general Shahrbaraz, a man of Armenian aristocratic descent, commanded the besieging army, in which heavily armoured cavalry, archers and siege engineers were mixed, while orders travelled down from the capital through the postal stations of Mesopotamia and the provincial garrisons were commanded by governors and counts in their own districts. The other side was the Byzantine Empire: Upper Mesopotamia and Syria were still administered by imperial governors and military commanders, Harran was held by regular troops and frontier units, and any relief army had to be drawn from the command posts at Antioch, Cappadocia and Lesser Armenia. For the first half of 610 the Byzantine throne was empty, Phocas had been overthrown, and Heraclius had taken the purple in Asia Minor, which left the chain of command on the eastern front broken for several months. The Sasanians also propped up a client regime, turning Harran and Edessa into bridgeheads for a counter-Byzantine movement. The border of the two empires lay directly beneath the walls of Harran: one side needed this hinge to open the northern road to Antioch, the other needed to hold it shut.
people: 沙赫巴巴茲是這一役的關鍵人物。他是薩珊王朝的將軍，父沙赫沙赫出身亞美尼亞貴族，603 年在達拉城下因拜占庭反地道作業而身亡；沙赫巴巴茲後來以果決與善於用兵在薩珊宮廷中嶄露頭角，610 年主持對哈蘭的長期圍城，選擇填壕、築壘、掘地道的路子，而不是只靠正面強攻。拜占庭方面，610 年之前掌權者是僭主福卡斯及其黨羽，鎮壓敘利亞與美索不達米亞的將領普里斯庫斯屢遭貶黜，菲利皮庫斯出任統帥後一味避戰，被赫拉克利烏斯免職。赫拉克利烏斯於 610 年秋進入君士坦丁堡，處決福卡斯，其後自任統帥並與兄弟狄奧多羅共掌軍權；他沒有選擇先救哈蘭，而是把哈蘭與埃德薩的失守視為必須反擊的既成事實。同期薩珊方面的沙欣、魯斯坦・法魯赫扎德分別在安條克與小亞美尼亞牽制拜占庭軍隊，圍城軍與援軍之間的時間差，正是哈蘭陷落得以發生的前提。
peopleEn: Shahrbaraz is the decisive figure of this campaign. He was a general of the Sasanian dynasty; his father Shakh-Shakh was of Armenian aristocratic descent and was killed in 603 beneath Dara when Byzantine counter-mining collapsed his tunnel. Shahrbaraz himself made his name at the Sasanian court for resolution and operational skill, and in 610 he directed the long siege of Harran, choosing to fill the ditch, raise earthen works and drive a mine rather than rely on a single frontal assault. On the Byzantine side the effective ruler before 610 was the usurper Phocas and his creatures. Priscus, who had crushed the revolt in Syria and Mesopotamia, was repeatedly demoted, and Philippicus, appointed commander-in-chief, was removed for refusing to engage the Persians. Heraclius entered Constantinople in the autumn of 610 and Phocas was executed; from then on Heraclius took command in person alongside his brother Theodore. He did not attempt to relieve Harran first, but treated the loss of Harran and Edessa as accomplished fact that had to be answered. On the Sasanian side Shahrpin and Rustam Farrokhzad were pinning down Byzantine forces at Antioch and in Lesser Armenia at the same time, and the gap in time between the besieging army and any relief force is precisely what made the fall of Harran possible.
kits: 本卡兵器是羅馬方陣盾（Scutum），共和國時期的凸面長方盾，以木框、夾層皮革與金屬飾釘製成，重約六至七公斤，高約一點二米，寬約六十厘米；它靠盾緣互扣形成連續盾牆，羅馬軍的防線因此不靠厚度而靠咬合。哈蘭城下，交戰雙方的裝備並不對稱。拜占庭守軍仍用大弧面盾一類的晚期軍用盾牌：守牆步兵把盾靠在垛口下承受投射物，衝鋒與反登城時再以盾緣互相扣住，組成密集盾列；帝國晚期的重裝步兵配備短劍與長矛，近身格鬥以盾緣砸擊對手。薩珊軍隊幾乎不用羅馬式大盾，步兵多為輕裝弓手與持矛者，重裝鐵甲騎兵自備小型圓盾或皮甲護具，騎射與迂迴是主力戰法，馬匹同時是最寶貴的運輸與機動工具。攻城裝備是這一役的關鍵：填壕的土方、逐步推近城牆的土壘、覆以濕皮或濕土的攻城塔、撞錘，以及在牆下挖掘的地道；守方依靠弩機、手持式氣壓弩、投石機與城頭簡易射擊陣位應對。城破之後，薩珊軍從城庫中取得的鐵料、繩索與皮料，被就地補進圍城器材。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman scutum, the convex rectangular shield of the Republic, built up on a wooden frame with layered leather and metal studs, weighing roughly six to seven kilograms, standing about one metre twenty high and sixty centimetres wide. It was made to be locked edge to edge into a continuous shield wall; the Roman line held not because the shield was thick but because the edges bit together. Beneath the walls of Harran the equipment of the two sides was not symmetrical. The Byzantine garrison still carried the large curved shields of the late imperial pattern: infantry on the wall rested the shield against the parapet to absorb missiles, and when charging or resisting a breach they locked edge to edge into close ranks. Late imperial heavy infantry carried the short sword and the spear, and in close fighting the shield rim itself was the weapon. The Sasanian army used almost no Roman-type large shields: most of its foot were light archers and spear-men, and the heavily armoured cavalry used small round shields or leather protection, with mounted shooting and envelopment as the main tactical method, the horse being at once the most valuable transport and the most valuable means of movement. Siege equipment was the heart of this campaign: earth to fill the ditch, earthen ramps advanced step by step towards the wall, siege towers sheathed in wet hides or sod, battering rams, and mines driven under the foundations. On the other side the defenders answered with arrow-shooting machines, the hand-held windlass ballista, stone-throwers and improvised firing positions along the parapet. After the city fell, the iron, rope and hides taken from the city stores were put straight back to work on the siege equipment.
tactics: 薩珊方採取的是典型的後期古代攻城序列：先以輕騎巡邏封鎖哈蘭周邊的商路與水源，逼城內消耗存糧；再以工兵在護城壕上填土築壘，把攻城塔與投射機位逐步推近城牆；同時在牆下挖掘地道，準備在某一處破壞基礎，讓城牆自行崩塌。哈蘭城牆在連年戰事後多處失修，東北角的土築段尤其脆弱，成為薩珊工兵著力之處。守方部署是縱深的：外城門設前哨與拒馬，城牆分區配置弩手與投石手，街道交會處築起街壘；一旦某段城牆失守，退守的守軍便在窄街內以盾牌立壁，重新組成數排盾牆，攔住湧入的波斯步兵。薩珊解圍步兵則以密集隊形在弩火掩護下推進，用撞錘與斧頭處理城門與壁壘。整場戰役中，雙方都沒有把騎兵送上城牆，騎兵的作用全在城外：薩珊騎兵在方圓數十里的平原上監視拜占庭援軍，阻止解圍部隊與守軍會合；而拜占庭騎兵因剛經過內戰，無法快速集結。哈蘭不是被一場會戰拿下，而是被一次長期的圍攻慢慢磨掉。
tacticsEn: The Sasanian side followed the standard late-antique sequence for a siege. Light cavalry patrols were used first to close the roads and the water sources around Harran and to force the city to burn through its stores. Engineers then filled the ditch and raised earthen ramps so that siege towers and missile batteries could be advanced towards the walls step by step, while mines were driven beneath the foundations to undermine a section and bring part of the wall down on its own. Harran's defences had been neglected through years of war, and the earthen stretch of the north-eastern sector was the most fragile point, so that is where the Sasanian engineers concentrated. The defence was laid out in depth: pickets and chevaux-de-frise covered the outer gate, bolt-shooters and stone-throwers were distributed along the walls, and street barricades were thrown up where the lanes crossed. When a section of wall was lost, the defenders who withdrew into the narrow streets set their shields on end and re-formed several ranks of shield wall to bar the Persian foot from pouring through. The Sasanian storming infantry advanced in close order under cover of the arrow fire, using ram and axe against the gate and the barricades. Throughout the campaign neither side put cavalry on the walls; the horsemen fought entirely in the open country beyond, the Sasanian riders patrolling the plain for tens of miles in every direction to watch for a Byzantine relief army and to prevent it from joining the garrison, while the Byzantine cavalry, freshly broken by civil war, could not concentrate quickly. Harran was not taken by a pitched battle; it was ground down by a siege.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，以下幾項較為可靠。戰爭整體：拜占庭-薩珊戰爭自 602 年打到 628 年，前後約二十六年。哈蘭圍城：起於 608 或 609 年，至 610 年陷落，歷時約一年；史料提示 602 至 620 年間的年份多為概數，月份無確載，本卡採 610 年 4 月，理由是上半年薩珊在美索不達米亞的攻勢與春季行軍季節相符。戰線推移：610 年之前薩珊已奪取幼發拉底河東岸的拜占庭城市，包括 605 年的達拉、609 年的馬爾丁與阿米達，以及 610 年陷落的埃德薩。距離：哈蘭在今土耳其舍利烏爾法省，位於幼發拉底河與哈蘭平原，距埃德薩約六十公里，安條克以東約四百公里，首都君士坦丁堡東南約一千一百公里；這些距離決定了哈蘭一旦失守，安條克便落在薩珊騎兵一日行程之內。裝備數據：羅馬方陣盾高約一點二米、寬約六十厘米、重約六至七公斤，帝國晚期同類大弧面盾略小而更淺。兵力：哈蘭一役的具體人數沒有可靠記載，只能確認圍城軍為數萬量級的混合兵種；同期可對照的是 617 年薩珊軍兵臨君士坦丁堡時，史料同樣只以數萬概數描述。
dataEn: There are not many numbers that can be checked, but the following are reasonably reliable. The war as a whole: the Byzantine-Sasanian War ran from 602 to 628, about twenty-six years in all. The siege of Harran: it began in 608 or 609 and Harran fell in 610, lasting roughly a year. The sources warn that the dates between 602 and 620 are approximate and that no month is recorded with certainty, so this card takes April 610, on the grounds that the Sasanian advance in Mesopotamia in the first half of the year fits the campaigning season of spring. The shifting front: by 610 the Persians had taken the Byzantine cities east of the Euphrates, including Dara in 605, Mardin and Amida in 609, and Edessa, which fell in 610. Distances: Harran lies in modern Şanlıurfa province in Turkey, on the Euphrates and the Harran plain, about sixty kilometres from Edessa, some four hundred kilometres east of Antioch and about eleven hundred kilometres south-east of Constantinople; those distances meant that once Harran fell, Antioch lay within a single day's ride of the Sasanian horse. Equipment figures: the Roman scutum stood about one metre twenty high, sixty centimetres wide and weighed some six to seven kilograms, while the great curved shields of the late imperial period were somewhat smaller and shallower. Numbers of men: no reliable figure survives for the action at Harran itself, and the besieging army can only be given as a mixed force of tens of thousands; a comparable near-contemporary case is the Sasanian army that stood before Constantinople in 617, which the sources likewise describe only as many tens of thousands.
cause: 哈蘭會被圍，首先因為它是薩珊西進的關鍵節點。602 年薩珊皇帝霍斯勞二世藉口 Maurice 被殺、其臣子納爾塞斯求援，入侵拜占庭的亞美尼亞與美索不達米亞；此後數年間，東線城池逐一易手，達拉、馬爾丁、阿米達、埃德薩相繼淪陷，薩珊軍的前沿推到上美索不達米亞的哈蘭。哈蘭扼守幼發拉底河上游與通往安條克的北道，又是敘利亞北部的貿易與軍糧節點，控制它等於把拜占庭的敘利亞省變成敞開的邊境。第二個原因是拜占庭內部的崩解：福卡斯弒君上台後清洗老臣，東部邊軍的指揮權反覆更替，美索不達米亞總督納爾塞斯據埃德薩起兵投向波斯，皇帝福卡斯派兵圍攻而兵敗，薩珊才名正言順地出兵；610 年赫拉克利烏斯政變推翻福卡斯，皇帝與主力都在西方，忙於收拾宮廷與埃及戰局，東線因此出現了長達數月的空窗。第三個原因是薩珊的戰術選擇：沙赫巴巴茲寧可花費一年圍一座城，也不願分兵冒險深入安條克，因為攻城成功的收益，遠勝過一次會戰的勝負。
causeEn: Harran was besieged above all because it was the hinge of the Sasanian advance to the west. In 602 the Sasanian king Khosrow II used the murder of Maurice and the appeal of his servant Narses as his pretext to invade Byzantine Armenia and Mesopotamia. Over the following years the eastern towns changed hands one by one: Dara, Mardin, Amida and Edessa fell in turn, and the Sasanian front was pushed up to Harran in Upper Mesopotamia. Harran commands the upper Euphrates and the northern road to Antioch, and it is also a node of the trade and military supply of northern Syria, so holding it meant turning the Byzantine province of Syria into an open border. The second cause was the collapse of Byzantium from within. After seizing the throne by murder, Phocas purged the old nobility, the command of the eastern frontier armies changed hands again and again, Narses, governor of Mesopotamia, rose in Edessa and threw in his lot with the Persians, and the army Phocas sent to besiege Edessa was defeated, which gave the Sasanians a formal reason to intervene. In 610 the Heraclian revolt overthrew Phocas, and with the emperor and the bulk of the army in the west, occupied with the court and the war in Egypt, the eastern front was left open for the better part of several months. The third cause was the Sasanian choice of method: Shahrbaraz preferred to spend a year over one city rather than split his force and run the risk of marching deep toward Antioch, because the prize of a successful siege was worth far more than the result of a single pitched battle.
impact: 哈蘭陷落是拜占庭-薩珊戰爭的戰略轉折之一。610 年起，薩珊控制幼發拉底河東岸全線，拜占庭在敘利亞的防線退到安條克與奇里乞亞的山道；其後數年薩珊軍在安條克擊敗拜占庭軍，攻入大馬士革，再取塔爾蘇斯與奇里乞亞平原，一度把帝國本土安納托利亞與敘利亞、巴勒斯坦、埃及切斷，君士坦丁堡與前線之間只剩繞行小亞細亞北部與海路兩條通路。哈蘭與埃德薩的陷落還讓薩珊得以在美索不達米亞扶植傀儡政權，把邊境城池的爭奪變成王位合法性的問題，直接促使赫拉克利烏斯放棄守城、率軍深入對方縱深：612 年他自卡佩冬尼亞越過小亞細亞，經亞美尼亞深入美索不達米亞，613 年在尼尼微附近大破薩珊軍，614 年初進軍泰西封、焚毀達斯塔基爾德。此後雙方拉鋸，617 年薩珊軍兵臨君士坦丁堡而無功而返，628 年拜占庭收復哈蘭與埃德薩，630 年凱瓦德二世議和，戰前邊界大致恢復。哈蘭其後在七世紀末落入阿拉伯統治，並成為早期伊斯蘭學術的重鎮之一。
impactEn: The fall of Harran was one of the strategic turning points of the Byzantine-Sasanian War. From 610 the Sasanians held the whole line east of the Euphrates and the Byzantine defence of Syria shrank back to Antioch and the passes of Cilicia; in the years that followed the Sasanian army beat the Byzantines near Antioch, entered Damascus and then took Tarsus and the Cilician plain, cutting for a time the empire's Anatolian core off from Syria, Palestine and Egypt, so that only the northern route through Asia Minor and the sea lanes still connected Constantinople with the front. The loss of Harran and Edessa also let the Sasanians set up a client regime in Mesopotamia, turning a contest over frontier towns into a question of dynastic legitimacy, and it was this that pushed Heraclius to give up on defence and march deep into the enemy's rear: in 612 he crossed Asia Minor from Cappadocia and came through Armenia into Mesopotamia, crushing the Sasanian army near Nineveh in 613 and entering Ctesiphon and burning Dastagird in early 614. The struggle then see-sawed; the Sasanian army stood before Constantinople in 617 and achieved nothing, the Byzantines recovered Harran and Edessa in 628, and Kavadh II made peace in 630, restoring very roughly the pre-602 frontier. Harran itself passed to Arab rule at the end of the seventh century and became one of the early centres of Islamic scholarship.
result: 結果是薩珊軍攻下哈蘭，拜占庭守軍在持久消耗後城破。圍城歷時約一年，薩珊以填壕、築壘逼近與牆下掘地道的組合，最終打開缺口；守軍在城內的抵抗隨存糧耗盡而瓦解，殘部被俘，城市的城防器材、糧秣與繩索鐵料落入薩珊之手，成為其後續攻勢的補給。消息傳到君士坦丁堡時，拜占庭正忙於福卡斯倒台後的權力交接，赫拉克利烏斯沒有立刻回師哈蘭，而是先在 612 年完成對安納托利亞的集結，再以連續打擊削弱薩珊縱深。哈蘭的陷落因此不是戰爭的終點，而是拜占庭由守轉攻的起點：它把一場邊境城池的得失，變成雙方傾盡資源的正面對撞。對哈蘭本身而言，它的軍事意義在 628 年被拜占庭收回，卻在不到半個世紀之後隨阿拉伯征服再易主，並在往後數百年成為哈蘭的伊斯蘭學派所在的城市。
resultEn: The result was that the Sasanian army took Harran and the Byzantine garrison was broken after a long wearing contest. The siege lasted about a year, and the Sasanians finally opened a breach by combining the filled ditch, the advanced earthen works and the mine driven beneath the wall; the resistance of the defenders collapsed as the stores ran out, the survivors were taken prisoner, and the city's artillery, provisions, rope and iron fell into Sasanian hands to feed the next stage of the offensive. When the news reached Constantinople the Byzantines were busy settling the succession after the fall of Phocas; Heraclius did not march back to Harran at once, but first completed the concentration of his army in Anatolia in 612 and then wore down the Sasanian rear with a series of strikes. The fall of Harran was therefore not the end of the war but the point at which Byzantium turned from defence to offence: it turned the loss of one frontier city into a head-on collision in which both empires committed everything they had. For Harran itself, its military importance was recovered by Byzantium in 628, but within less than half a century it changed hands again with the Arab conquest, and over the following centuries it became the city of the Harran school of Islamic thought.
